high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Victoria Beckham, as indicated by the username "victoriabeckham" at the top left corner. The post was made 37 minutes prior to the screenshot being taken, as shown by the timestamp "37 m" next to the username. The main focus of the image is a bouquet of light pink roses arranged in a clear glass vase. The roses are fresh and have a soft, delicate appearance. The green stems and leaves of the roses are visible, adding a natural touch to the arrangement. The vase is placed on a surface with a black-and-white checkered pattern
